meta.notice: Independent and unofficial. This comparison is our own reading of the published documents, not an official record of the budget department, the agencies or the House. Figures are the amounts published in the documents, not spending. No allegations. An insertion, deletion, or amount-change candidate describes a provisional comparison between identified sources. That classification alone does not establish irregularity or wrongdoing by any office or official and should not be represented as such. Absence from an API snapshot likewise does not establish absence from the published NEP or concealment. Read the full notice: https://budget.bettergov.ph/hgab/2027/methodology#disclaimer.
meta.tier_meaning: Tier A: the office serves one district, so its figure can be read as that district’s. Tier B: the office serves several districts, so the figure is shared and is not split between them.
meta.representatives_note: Representatives are listed so a reader can find their district. Nothing here establishes that a representative requested, sponsored or controlled any project or amount.
meta.note: DPWH money by the district engineering office the documents list, with the congressional districts each office serves. No project is assigned to a district; a shared office's money is never divided. Headline amounts are the undivided totals of the serving offices. Money on no district card is in residual.

disclaimers.title: Office and legislative-district associations.
disclaimers.body: The DEO mapping associates offices with legislative districts; it does not establish that a representative requested, sponsored, or controlled a project, or that each project lies in every district associated with its office. Shared-office totals remain undivided and must not be split among the districts served. Office-based views must retain attribution tiers, co-served districts, unattributable residuals, and upstream uncertainty annotations. Historical or undated amounts retained as mapping evidence are separate from the FY2027 project ledger and must not be quoted as FY2027 allocations. See the DEO mapping restrictions.

data.residual_note: Every year's DPWH total split into money under offices that appear on a district card (deo_php) and money on no district card: the Central Office, regional offices, and office names that matched nothing (not_on_any_district_php). Nine slots: FY2020–2026 enacted, FY2027 NEP, FY2027 House bill. For the FY2027 House bill only (0 for the enacted years and the NEP): no_office_php / no_office_rows are lines whose grouped records name no office (the source's no_office bucket). office_change_php / office_change_rows are paired lines whose NEP and House bill sides name different office groups (or one side names no district office). Both are held out of every office and every district card and counted in not_on_any_district_php. deo + central_office + regional_offices + unmatched + no_office + office_change = total.
